text:
hannah: Quick note from the onboarding paired session: hit a UX+bug combo with Generator context propagation + auth retry. Posting repro and suggested ergonomics.

hannah: Repro: start generator with parent ctx, read one chunk, then cancel parent ctx. generator goroutine lingers because auth refresher spawns its own ctx that doesn't get cancelled.

hannah: Minimal snippet:
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
iter, err := client.Generator(ctx, req)
if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
_ = iter.Next()
cancel()
// expect iter.Next or iter.Close to return quickly but it blocks
```

mike: Thanks. Curious whether this is specific to Generator.Iter or also affects Stream callback. We saw earlier that Stream's backpressure can hide these leaks.

hannah: Both. Stream blocks on chan send, Iter blocks in handshake goroutine. Common root: some background tasks (auth refresh + retry) use a derived context that never observes the original cancel.

ana: small fix: thread the original ctx into all helper goroutines and ensure selects include <-ctx.Done() on channel sends. That should make cancellation deterministic.

mike: Agreed. From a DX standpoint, we should also make the API clearer: the generator should document cancel behaviour and maybe return an explicit closer: `iter, shutdown := client.Generator(ctx, req)` or have `iter.CloseWithTimeout(ctx, timeout)` so callers don't need hacks.

hannah: Parity note: Python and Node SDKs have explicit async iterator close semantics (`aclose()` / `.return()`), Go should mirror this with Stop/ForceStop or a context-based Close. New users expect similar patterns across languages.

mike: Implementation plan: 1) short-term: make auth refresher accept parent ctx and add select on channel sends; 2) medium: add iter.Stop() + iter.ForceStop(); 3) docs update & quickstart patch. I'll open a PR for (1) and a small RFC for (2).

ana: Can we also add a BackpressurePolicy opt to the Generator opts so demo apps can pick BufferWithTimeout vs block? reduces workshop friction.

hannah: Yes please. I'll add a note to the onboarding checklist and attach a tiny repro test to the issue.

devex-bot: Issue created: DEX-5077 "go generator ctx leak during auth retry + streaming backpressure" (assignee: mike) :white_check_mark:

hannah: thanks! tagging docs to update quickstart examples with Stop/ForceStop patterns and an explicit "streaming gotchas" section. :thumbsup:
